exact_source_defect_matrix.causal_repair: Propagated selected_sweep_id, selected_break_id, selected_fvg_id, and selected_breaker_id onto base_rec and re-derived verified causal feature snapshots on SI8-discovered candidates.
exact_source_defect_matrix.root_cause: base_rec for discovered_by_si8=True candidates omitted selected_sweep_id, selected_break_id, selected_fvg_id, and selected_breaker_id before calling derive_pre_entry_features_from_causal_context_v1793127, causing 0 / 6,375 SI8-discovered candidates to pass required_proof_rejection_v1793127.

exact_source_defect_matrix.causal_repair: Indexed exact detector raw_id, canonical_anchor_id, canonical_target_id, contiguous window checks, 4H (1,1) pools, and post-pivot m1_post_bar_idx (occ_ms + tf_dur_ms).
exact_source_defect_matrix.root_cause: all_causal_swings synthesized IDs '{TF}_{lb}_{rb}_{SH/SL}_{occ_ms}' instead of canonical detector IDs ('1m_sh/sl_...' / 'v1792_m5_5m_sh/sl_...' for anchors; 'pool_{TF}_{tf}_sh/sl_...' for targets) and checked M1 sweep inside the HTF pivot candle itself, causing rebuild_materialized_intent_proof_v1793127 to reject re-derived stops/targets.

exact_source_defect_matrix.causal_repair: Delegated use_structural_evaluator=True to evaluate_htf_structure on strictly closed 4H/1H/15m/5m candles (close_time <= new_decision_timestamp_ms), rejecting MISSING/UNDETERMINED/MIXED/COUNTERTREND.
exact_source_defect_matrix.root_cause: Legacy 6-bar close-comparison heuristic contradicted evaluate_htf_structure on 113 / 113 genuinely BEARISH/BEARISH (ALIGNED) SHORT candidates in SI8.

exact_source_defect_matrix.causal_repair: Scaled pre-materialization ATR ceiling by timeframe sqrt(tf_minutes) (12.0 * sqrt(tf_mins)) and enforced full emit_causal_order_intents_v1793121 + rebuild_materialized_intent_proof_v1793127 on all SI8/SI9 winners.
exact_source_defect_matrix.root_cause: SI9 enforced 0.30 <= target_room_atr_m1 <= 12.0 using 1M ATR on 1H liquidity pools (~14.2 ATR_1m = ~1.8 ATR_1h) before materialization, falsely rejecting 267 / 267 proven-unswept 1H pools.
